description: Assemble a markdown pretest report (how we worked, one section per set, what the results mean, sealed predictions appendix) from finished simulations. Deterministic unless generateFixes is true (then the model drafts fixes and a one-line summary per set, if enabled on the account); otherwise the recommended fixes are left as placeholders for the analyst. Returns the markdown plus claim-lint warnings to resolve before sending. Seals each set's prediction as a side effect. Results are simulated, not real-user data. For a branded PDF, open the same report in the app at /dashboard/ad-lab/pretest and use Download PDF.

generateFixes.description: Ask the model to draft 3-5 concrete fixes and a one-line summary per set. Default false.

regulated.description: True for regulated sectors; claims are linted harder.

sets.description: 1-12 finished runs, one report section each.

assumptions.description: Assumptions to state in this set's section.

id.description: Comparison, video analysis or research run id.

kind.description: Which kind of finished run this set is.

name: aetherya_pretest_report
title: Build a pretest report
